competitors.name: QuickBooks Self-Employed
competitors.description: Cloud accounting software designed specifically for freelancers and gig workers.
complaints: Customer support is unresponsive and prices increase arbitrarily every year
Mileage tracking is buggy and drains smartphone battery rapidly
Doesn't understand modern multi-currency crypto or international invoice flows
Costs $25/mo just to categorize transactions I could do in a spreadsheet
Forces you into their ecosystem — exporting data to switch is deliberately painful

competitors.name: FreshBooks
competitors.description: Invoice and accounting software for small businesses and independent contractors.
complaints: Charges per active client which punishes agencies with one-off clients
Lacks automated AI receipt reconciliation and smart tax write-off suggestions
Time tracking feature is half-baked and doesn't integrate with project management tools

competitors.name: Wave Accounting
competitors.description: Free invoicing and accounting with paid payroll and payment processing.
complaints: Eliminated free bank transaction sync, locking it behind paid tiers
Zero AI assistance for category matching or tax deductions
Interface feels stuck in 2018, no modern dark mode or mobile-first design

competitors.name: Bench
competitors.description: Human-powered bookkeeping service paired with proprietary software.
complaints: Costs $300+/mo — absurd for solo freelancers earning under $100K
Human bookkeepers make errors and take days to respond to questions
Went bankrupt and got acquired, leaving thousands of clients scrambling for alternatives

competitors.name: Keeper Tax
competitors.description: AI tax assistant that finds write-offs by scanning bank transactions.
complaints: Flags personal purchases as deductions too aggressively, creating audit risk
Limited to US federal taxes, no state or international support
Can't handle complex freelancer scenarios like partial business-use deductions

raw_complaint_pool: I spent 14 hours over the weekend matching receipts to invoices for tax season.
Accounting apps charge $40/month just to send 3 PDF invoices to clients.
Categorizing transactions manually in 2026 feels archaic when LLMs exist.
Why can't an AI look at my bank feed and draft my schedule C deductions automatically?
I got hit with a $2,400 penalty because my bookkeeper missed a quarterly estimated payment deadline.
Every freelancer I know either overpays taxes out of fear or underpays and gets audited. There's no middle ground.
I pay $360/year for QuickBooks and I still have to hire a CPA for $800 to file. What exactly am I paying for?
My accountant told me I missed $11,000 in legitimate home office deductions last year. An AI should have caught that.
The fact that I have to photograph receipts, upload them, then MANUALLY match them to transactions is insane in the age of AI.
